mechanism: Amphotericin B causes nephrotoxicity and electrolyte abnormalities (hypokalemia, hypomagnesemia) that impair glucose homeostasis and reduce insulin sensitivity, while systemic infection/sepsis from treated condition increases insulin requirements.
action: Monitor blood glucose closely and adjust insulin aspart dosing as needed; monitor renal function, electrolytes (especially potassium and magnesium), and fluid status regularly during concurrent therapy.
